source: https://dash.voidbind.com/recent_blocks and /luck_stats (public endpoints, c2pool-dash relay node, a build that serves no effort/periods/current_round)
note: recent_blocks rows reduced to the columns the luck code reads; hash = last 16 hex digits; expected_time rounded to 1 ms, luck to 4 decimals
reference_note: pooled_reference computed independently in Python, the way the node computes its periods: k = main-chain blocks in the span; expected = sum of time_to_find / expected_time over them, the round that straddles the start of the span counted for the part inside it, plus the open round effort 100 / current_luck_trend; a round the node timed from an orphaned row is timed from the previous main-chain block; the first block is effort 1
